purpose: Define what MuMu's bundled JCC gameassist package can and cannot prove for runtime live_state.
live_state_boundary: MuMu gameassist contains OCR, screen capture, lineup, and recommendation structures. It may expose candidate screen-derived hero/shop/bench/action observations, but current APK/database evidence does not prove a complete current local board_units or bench_units snapshot. Promote only when runtime-local binding and deterministic action folding are proven.
pollution_guard: Never merge MuMu gameassist candidates into board_units or bench_units unless the local player binding is strongly_bound and candidates are replayed through a verified state transition reducer.
